verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SPF/DKIM authentication and DMARC support as features (mailgun-docs-9, mailgun-docs-10, mailgun-docs-28) and note that custom domain setup requires configuring a DKIM DNS record (mailgun-docs-21), implying Mailgun supplies these records, but there is no documentation confirming that Mailgun auto-generates the *exact* SPF/DKIM/DMARC records or exposes a dedicated API field for verification status. Community evidence even shows a user struggling with the DNS validation dashboard reporting 'unresolved problems with no details' and unhelped support (mailgun-comm-6), casting doubt on how transparent/reliable verification status reporting is in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic exact-record generation, an API endpoint/field exposing per-record verification status, and clean corroboration that verification works reliably end-to-end.
